LanguageData.ProjectZ.OpenWindowDesc: Have a colonist slide the boards apart: light and air pass through.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.CloseWindowDesc: Have a colonist slide the boards shut.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.OpenThisSideDesc: Swing the sashes out to this face of the wall. Light and air pass through.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.OpenOtherSideDesc: Swing the sashes out to the opposite face of the wall. Light and air pass through.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.CloseSashesDesc: Shut the sashes: no light or air passes through.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.NeedHalfWall: A window has to go on a half wall: build one in this cell first.
LanguageData.ProjectZ.HalfWallHasWindow: This half wall already has a window: a half wall takes one window.
